notes.title: Nuts Dropped! Trade Up Contracts Coming Soon
notes.content:
[b]The Day 1 drop table is 1000x more likely to drop an Ultra Rare or Legendary.[/b]

[b] Here are the Day 1 drop rates:[/b]

[list]
[*] 58% Common
[*] 34% Uncommon
[*] 8% ~ Rare
[*] 1/4000 Ultra Rare
[*] 1/28000 Legendary
[/list]

[b]Trade up contracts and customization will be finalized and added to the game within the next couple of days. Drop rates on trade up contracts will be as follows:[/b]

[list]
[*] 10 Common Nuts > 10% chance to trade up to an Uncommon Nut
[*] 10 Uncommon Nuts > 5% chance to trade up to an Rare Nut
[*] 10 Rare Nuts > 2% chance to trade up to an Ultra Rare Nut
[*] 10 Ultra Rare Nuts > 1% chance to trade up to a Legendary Nut
[/list]

[u]Subject to change.[/u]

Make sure to come join The Nut House if you haven't already!
